metadata.title: The Undersized Steel Plate That Dropped a Freeway
metadata.description:
I-35W Bridge dropped into the Mississippi River during rush hour. The cause: undersized gusset plates failing under added dead load and construction materials.

Failure chain: Gusset plates designed too thin → Decades of added concrete weight → Construction load parked on deck → Plate at U10 gives way → Main span falls

Related episode: Tasman Bridge: What Failed First — https://youtu.be/SjJHvPtSvcg

Technical references:
• Wikipedia — I-35W Mississippi River bridge — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I-35W_Mississippi_River_bridge
• NTSB Highway Accident Report HAR-08-03 — Collapse of I-35W Highway Bridge — https://www.ntsb.gov/investigations/AccidentReports/Reports/HAR0803.pdf

Narration uses a synthetic voice. Original animation: no archival or stock footage; reconstructions and illustrations are labelled on screen.
